name: v2.0.6 Stable
notes:
### Release Notes

* **Zero-Lag Canvas Rendering**: Integrated Min-Max screen decimation algorithms and O(log N) binary search crosshairs, eliminating all lag and frame drops during long monitoring sessions.
* **Unlimited Network History**: Removed the 5-minute data restriction across timeline and detail views, supporting full 24-hour continuous ICMP retention without performance degradation.
* **Offline Launch Resilience**: Optimized font loading in WebView2 to prevent startup blocking when operating without an active internet connection.
* **Single-Pass Gradient & Overlap Optimization**: Cached canvas gradients and merged overlapping sub-pixel packet-loss bars for smooth 60 FPS rendering under heavy packet loss.
